Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Down syndrome investigation

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

PRELIMINARY TESTING
Rapid PCR for aneuploidy detection was performed prior to karyotype analysis. Results indicated no evidence of trisomy 21, 18, or 13.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype. No trisomy 21 or other major chromosomal abnormalities detected.

METHOD
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured and harvested according to standard protocols. G-banded metaphase chromosomes were analyzed at a resolution of 450-550 bands. A minimum of 20 cells were examined.

QUALITY STATEMENT
This analysis meets laboratory quality standards with adequate metaphase quality and band resolution for detection of numerical and structural chromosomal abnormalities.

INTERPRETATION
This result excludes Down syndrome and other major chromosomal abnormalities detectable by conventional karyotyping. The normal karyotype finding is consistent with the preliminary rapid PCR results.

LIMITATIONS
This test cannot detect chromosomal mosaicism below 10% or subtle structural rearrangements below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics.

Authorized by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Date: [redacted date]
